body: @mkouba does it ring a bell? It looks like the producer bean is present twice.
Hm, @chrismanning does it only occur when you're running the test from the IDE?

@mkouba it only happens in the IDE for the simplified example I've described, but my actual application also fails with the same error when run with `mvn clean compile test`. I'll see what I can do about making it available

>  I'll see what I can do about making it available

That would be great!

https://github.com/chrismanning/quarkus-datasource-test

Forgive the legacy stank on it ;)

Ok so the real problem is that `quarkus-agroal-deployment` depends on `quarkus-narayana-jta-deployment` but `quarkus-agroal` does not depend on `quarkus-narayana-jta` (runtime artifact). As a result the `NarayanaJtaProducers` class is not found and the `QuarkusTestExtension` fails. However, for some reason the Quarkus attempts to start again and since the generated classes are not removed from `target/test-classes` and `target/test-classes` is considered an additional bean archive (if it contains a bean with a bean defining annotation) the build fails again with `AmbiguousResolutionException`.

I'm going to send a PR with the fix for `quarkus-agroal` POM shortly. 

Hey @stuartwdouglas, it would be great if you could look at the reproducer too. We should IMHO fix `QuarkusTestExtension` to always delete the generated classes from `target/test-classes`. And do you know why `QuarkusTestExtension` attempts to build the app again?
